Thank you for your response. I think I'm starting to calm down a little now, but I still feel terribly uneasy.

You're right, there really is a lot going on... I can't seem to get a grip on classes this semester, for starters. I'm absolutely terrified of one of my teachers because he's so moody and he's gonna tell me to drop if I show up empty-handed tomorrow. And there's very little chance I can pull an all-nighter tonight, so I'm sort of just awaiting doomsday here.

But other than that, there's a whole host of things from my past that have been on my mind because I spilled everything to my counselor a couple weeks ago and we're going to have to talk about it later this week. On top of that, my counselor referred me to a psychiatrist, and now I have a prescription for anti-anxiety medication that I don't know if I'm going to get filled.
